system_amendments.mechanics_no_act_admin: Mechanics no act, admin panel, or office can touch. A change here is a new release of the software that must pass every automated constitutional check before it ships — softening exists only through this door, in the open, with the change and its checks on the public record.
system_amendments.no_amendments_yet_ever: No amendments yet — every change will appear here, appended, never edited.
system_amendments.ratification_threshold: Ratification thresholds by kind of change
system_amendments.read_the_template_a_fa: Read the Template — A Fair Constitution (Cosmopolitan Template) →
system_amendments.releases_are_sealed_in: Releases are sealed in the audit chain
system_amendments.settings_the_constitut: Settings the constitution leaves to each jurisdiction, changed by a valid legislative act (an amendable setting change) through the ordinary bill flow. The engine blocks out-of-range values before the vote is even scheduled. Every applied change lands here, on the live ledger — appended, never edited.
system_amendments.supermajority_glossed_: Supermajority, glossed: the share of every seated member — vacant seats still count in the denominator until refilled — so absence can never lower the bar.
system_amendments.the_constitution_chang: The constitution changes through exactly two doors. The settings it leaves open move by ordinary legislative acts, inside locked bounds. The locked core itself (the hardened layer) moves only by a new release of the software, made in the open with every constitutional check passing publicly. Nothing changes silently, and nothing changes any other way.
system_amendments.the_supermajority_frac: The supermajority fraction is amendable, but its definition has a hardened floor: no redefinition may produce a threshold below majority + 1 of all serving members. The default is two thirds, computed as — against members serving, never members present.
system_amendments.this_screen_shows_the_: This screen shows the two ways the constitution can change — the settings door runs through the amendable setting change and the ordinary bill flow, and every change is sealed in the audit chain. Amendable settings are scoped per jurisdiction; ratification climbs the nesting chain through constituent supermajorities. In engineering terms, the hardened layer is a set of protected files guarded by the constitutional test suite — a release deploys only when the full suite passes.
system_auditchain.everything_that_happen: Everything that happens here — every vote, ruling, election, and rule change — is written into one permanent history that no one, not an operator, a legislator, or a judge, can quietly change. Moves the rules forbid are refused, and the refusal itself is recorded. Nothing is ever removed.
system_auditchain.full_chain_verificatio: Full-chain verification recomputes every link and is operator-triggered; the result is recorded when it runs.
system_auditchain.genesis_prev_hash_ever: Genesis prev-hash: {shortHash} · every link satisfies hash(n) = H(hash(n−1) ∥ payload(n)).
system_auditchain.invalid_transitions_re: Invalid transitions rejected pre-commit; complete tamper-evident history · Art. VII · CGA §6.2, §6.4
system_auditchain.latest_first_stored_as: Latest first · stored as UTC, shown as UTC.
system_auditchain.recomputes_all_link_ha: Recomputes all {count} link hashes against the head.
system_auditchain.the_chain_is_empty_no_: The chain is empty — no filings yet.
system_auditchain.wf_sys_04_the_constitu: WF-SYS-04 — the constitutional engine intercepts every transition pre-commit; accepted ones are appended here, invalid ones are rejected with their citation and the rejection is appended too. Ballot and residency identities are never written in clear — commitments and day-counts only.
system_clocks.amendable_means_a_valid_le: Amendable means a valid legislative act can change the default within fixed bounds — see amendments; hardened and structural clocks are fixed in code.
system_clocks.countdowns_rolling_deadlin: Countdowns, rolling deadlines, and bounded or continuous windows.

system_clocks.every_fire_event_is_append: Every fire event is appended to the audit chain.
system_clocks.glossary_quorum_here_alway: Glossary: quorum here always counts all serving members, never just those present; the Droop quota is the smallest vote count that mathematically guarantees a seat; the number of ballot finalists grows with the seats in the race.
system_clocks.live_is_what_the_scheduler: Live is what the scheduler is actually holding right now — armed timers and the soonest real deadline, straight from the timer table.
system_clocks.quantity_watchers_populati: Quantity watchers — population, headcount, signatures, seats.
system_clocks.recurring_and_derived_sche: Recurring and derived schedules — the clocks that re-arm themselves.
system_clocks.the_scheduled_sweeps_that_: The scheduled sweeps that drive the world — every interval, deadline, window, and threshold that starts a process without anyone asking. Time and population do the triggering; officials never do, and nothing here needs a human to remember it.
system_clocks.the_scheduler_itself_is_th: The scheduler itself is the engine behind term synchronization and 90-day meeting enforcement. This page doubles as the scheduler spec — the production scheduler implements exactly these clock records, one row, one trigger source. Amendable defaults change by legislative act; hardened and structural clocks are fixed in code. Clocks themselves hold no state — they move other things (elections, emergency powers, vacancies, residency claims) through their stages.
system_clocks.type_is_the_scheduler_cont: Type is the scheduler contract: recurring intervals re-arm on fire; countdowns expire once; windows open and close; thresholds watch a quantity and fire on crossing.
system_publicrecords.corrections_append_: Corrections append a superseding entry; nothing is deleted or rewritten. Every entry is sealed into the cryptographically chained audit log at commit time. Art. II §2 · WF-SYS-03 · WF-SYS-04

system_publicrecords.entered_verbatim_in: entered verbatim into the immutable public record · WF-SYS-03 · sealed into the audit chain at commit
system_publicrecords.every_statement_bil: Every statement, bill, vote, and explanation made in your jurisdictions — published the moment it is recorded, readable by anyone, and never edited in place. This is the surface the constitution calls "public and readily available records".

system_termsync.jurisdictions_activate_a: Jurisdictions activate at their own thresholds as populations reach critical mass (CLK-06), so clocks start staggered. Lockstep harmonization toward a shared election day is an encompassing-level end-state that arrives as participation grows.
